question: Why did the great fish equal in strength to the speaker fail to come?
premises: That great fish did not come
The fish was equal in strength to the speaker
inference: Despite being equal in strength to the speaker, that great fish did not arrive.
uncertainties: The form mahāmatsyā is nonstandard for mahāmatsyaḥ
plain_english: O beloved, that great fish, equal to me in strength, did not come.
